Откройте сами не меньше 3 ссылок из разных разделов, все ссылки строки Claude Code и не меньше 5 ссылок из новых строк; если страница вендора изменилась после времени проверки исследователя (06:42Z 2026-10-01), укажите расхождение и время вашей проверки — это замечание, а не повод молчать. Все открытые URL — в result.urls_opened.
Проверяете только этот файл; файл session-review-tools.md в это время дорабатывает другой запуск (AP-008). Файл не правите — только отчёт.
result.verdict — «PASS» или «FAIL»; при FAIL — каждое замечание с местом и конкретным исправлением.

PASS. Every request was bounded by curl --max-time 30-40 and tool timeouts (this macOS shell has no `timeout` binary). I found no wrong cell value, quote, price, marker, heading or conclusion boundary. I found three statements about what particular pages contain that are wrong, stale or mis-evidenced (R1-R3 below). None changes a table value, so they are not FAIL reasons; if ORCH wants them fixed, any edit after this PASS needs a new check.

FORMAT (REQ-006 criteria 1-2), my own commands: «## Что нашли (проверено 2026-09-30)» line 43 and «## Где искали» line 853, one each; the first «### » after «Что нашли» is exactly the required question (line 45); «### Покрытие разбора всей сессии» line 106; grep -Fxc of the header row = 1; 32 rows x 11 columns; the six element columns hold only да/частично/нет/не найдено; every row with да/частично/нет has links in «Источники»; every «не найдено» row has a «Где искали» entry naming the same elements (script, 0 problems); the five required rows (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Claude (приложения и claude.ai)) are present. Market marks: of 101 top-level blocks only the same 6 navigation/method notes lack one; [вендор], [независимо], [СМИ], [пользователь] and the new [сторонний блог] fit their sources (the Codex issue author has author_association NONE). One conclusion pair, lines 1058/1156; a scan of everything before it for evaluative wording gave only incidental hits. The conclusion agrees with the table: 32 rows; «да» only for Devin (4 cells) and Augment Code (2); the 13 other added platforms split 10 + 3 as stated.

EARLIER FINDINGS, all resolved, with my evidence:
- F1 resolved. Every Codex CLI fact now cites the GitHub release pages (lines 65-68, row 113, 384-401, 938-946). I opened both: every quoted line is on rust-v0.156.0 (22.09.2026) and rust-v0.159.0 (29.09.2026); PR #48352 says what the file reports (random tip after 30 s; completion tips only after successful turns, at most two per app session).
- F2 resolved. Row 126 and lines 611-622 now say the quota is personal and set by the member's subscription, the administrator assigns it, the licence is paid monthly; the «закрепляется за организацией» sentence is placed in the archived Code Assistant Pro plan. All matches the live sourcecraft.dev pricing text; the ₽ and ₸ prices match.
- C1 resolved: cursor.com/pricing lists Pro $20, Pro+ $60, Ultra $200 and Teams $40 in its structured data and a Pro/Pro+/Ultra picker (the visible text shows only $20, and the file says where the numbers come from).
- C2 and C3 resolved: the Antigravity Walkthrough and /learn quotes and the Codex Usage Insights quote (typographic apostrophe) are verbatim on the live pages.
- C4 resolved: row 110 «Кто платит» no longer says API payment is organisation-only.
- N1 resolved: the Reflect text (4D framework, «Description», «examples of how you tend to collaborate with Claude») is quoted exactly; the new «Вмешательства: частично» fits the file's own rule (summary over many chats).

CLAUDE CODE ROW: all 8 links opened and compared; every value matches (/insights, /recap, /usage, agent view, Zolkos facets, 50 sessions then and 200 now, all prices incl. Max 5x/20x, Free without Claude Code, Kazakhstan in both Anthropic lists). No command in the live reference does a per-session review beyond /insights, /recap, /rewind, /feedback.

NEW AND CHANGED ROWS (14 new, 6 changed): all their pages opened; prices, quotes and statuses match for Cline, Kilo Code, Roo Code, Roomote, Continue, Zed, Warp, Augment Code, Tabnine, Amazon Q Developer, ChatGPT Work, Manus, Bolt, Lovable (redirects roocode.com to roomote.dev seen 06:53Z and tabnine.com to tricentis.com 06:54Z; Roo Code repository archived 15.05.2026; Continue and Tabnine acquisitions; AWS post 30.04.2026; also «Не открылись» claims: Continue mission-control 404, Roo docs page empty, manus.im/pricing without amounts). Augment Code, the only new row with «да»: «Ошибки: да» is supported (sessions-overview: the Advisor diagnoses a failed, stalled or bad Session, names the root cause and points at the fix). «Советы: да» rests on the same sentence; the cross-session advice (edit the prompt) is «частично» by the file's own rule and the Advisor overview describes it as fleet tuning, which the conclusion (lines 1077-1081) says honestly. I accept both cells; step 2b should read this row with that nuance. Whole-file checks: all 157 English quotes inside «Что нашли» appear on a page cited in their own bullet (0 missing; across the whole file the only misses of 226 were 65 search queries in «Где искали» and 4 spacing or backtick artefacts I checked by hand); every amount in the 32 «Цена» cells and 135 numbers in prose match their cited pages (6 flags explained: GigaCode ₽ page returns 429 to curl and WebFetch shows «от 1699₽»; Cursor $60/$200 in structured data; tokenising artefacts).

INCLUSION RULE AND CHATGPT AGENT: the rule (lines 26-30) is applied to the 14 platforms of the old list (13 rows plus the documented exception) and Roomote. ChatGPT agent mode is justified in substance: help.openai.com/en/articles/11752874-chatgpt-agent and openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-agent/ return HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch (06:54-06:55Z), so they were not opened; the evidence the file names is another page (R3). OpenCode, Crush and Zoo Code, seen only in search results and not opened, have no row (lines 1054-1056; N2).

VENDOR PAGE DRIFT: Antigravity walkthrough, slash-commands, pricing and cli/usage pages were fetched 06:45:43-06:46:01Z and again 06:56:47-06:56:49Z; page text identical; the file's quotes and prices match both. learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog changed after the researcher's check: R2.

CORRECTIONS (not FAIL reasons; location as checked; concrete fix):
R1 (wrong statement about a page; lines 669-672, 1049-1050, and change [11] in the researcher's r2 report): the file says the Roomote pages do not state that the same team makes Roo Code, and that Roo Code appears only in a customer testimonial. https://roomote.dev/ shows above its headline «By the creators of» followed by the Roo Code logo (image alt «Roo Code»; raw HTML at 07:01Z, confirmed with WebFetch), and its repository is github.com/RooCodeInc/Roomote, in the same organisation as Roo-Code (gh api: created 2026-07-07, not archived). Text-only extraction drops alt text. Fix: replace those sentences with: над заголовком страницы — "By the creators of" и логотип Roo Code; репозиторий — github.com/RooCodeInc/Roomote, в той же организации, что Roo-Code; в отзыве клиента — "It's like when I tried Roo Code for the first time... But better."; keep two rows (two products, different status) and give that reason at 1049-1050. Table values do not change.
R2 (stale statement; lines 406-408 and 939-940): the file says CLI 0.156.0 and 0.159.0 are no longer on learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog on 2026-10-01. At 06:45:43Z, 06:50:49-06:51:07Z and 06:57:51-55Z (also without compression, with and without a user agent) the page lists «Codex CLI 0.156.0» (2026-09-22) and «Codex CLI 0.159.0» (2026-09-29) with all the quoted lines, among 12 CLI-tagged entries; in my first check (about 01:30Z) it had none, so it changed between those times. The facts stay correctly sourced to GitHub. Fix: delete both sentences and say only that the CLI facts are cited to the release pages and that the changelog page changes between loads.
R3 (evidence for the ChatGPT agent exception; lines 767-772, 1031-1032, 1051-1052): the 403 page named is the ChatGPT release notes (articles/6825453), not an agent page. Fix: name help.openai.com/en/articles/11752874-chatgpt-agent (the article the Carly blog links to) and openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-agent/ with HTTP 403 and the date; optionally add community.openai.com/t/agent-mode-was-removed-with-no-real-replacement/1389601 (HTTP 200 at 06:54Z) as [пользователь].
R4 (rule text against rows; lines 26-30 and rows 116, 136, 137): the rule says a sold, renamed or closed product has that stated in «Рынок», but Devin Desktop, Tabnine and Amazon Q Developer have only «[мир]» there (the facts are in the name or in «Цена»). Fix: add «Windsurf переименован в Devin Desktop», «компания куплена Tricentis 30.07.2026», «закрыт для новых клиентов с 15.05.2026» to «Рынок», or change the rule to «Цена» or «Рынок».
R5 (dates; lines 6-7): «каждый факт ниже взят со страницы, открытой 2026-09-30» contradicts lines 9-16. Fix: «факты первой версии — со страниц, открытых 2026-09-30; добавленные и исправленные в r2 — 2026-10-01». The heading date 2026-09-30 is conservative, not misleading: all quotes and prices still match on 2026-10-01, and the added or corrected items carry «(проверено 2026-10-01)».

NOTES: N1 (row 134, line 702): Warp's own text says a run opens with «prompt, plan, commands, logs, messages, and output», yet «Постановка задачи» is «не найдено», while Cowork's plan counts as «частично» for Claude; treatment of shown prompts and plans is not uniform (also Jules, Antigravity /plan). A uniform rule cannot create a «да». N2: REQ-006 criterion 2 says «каждой другой найденной платформы», while the task rule says «найдено и открыто»; OpenCode, Crush (line 1055) and Zoo Code have no row because they were not opened. This follows the rule ORCH gave, but step 4 should know the tension; fix if wanted: open each official page and add a row.
